name: 炎黄2003
english_description: 炎黄2003 (YHLib), the MudRen-preserved base library of the Yan-Huang lineage of Chinese wuxia MUDs — the ES II / Annihilator / xkx-rooted tree from which later 炎黄武魂 and 炎黄英雄史 snapshots descend. New characters register with an English id, Chinese surname and given name, dual admin/regular passwords, an aptitude pick, and gender, then enter 世外桃源 with NPCs 水笙 and 狄云.
